Congratulations to fellow Floridian, @emilmichael, on his confirmation as Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering.

With a distinguished career in technological innovation and business leadership, Emil is uniquely equipped to drive the critical advancements that will shape the future of our national defense. His experience in cutting-edge research and fostering breakthrough technologies will ensure that our brave servicemembers have the tools and resources needed to confront modern threats.

As the Pentagon’s Chief Technology Officer, I am confident he will lead the Department of Defense in pioneering advancements in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and next-generation defense systems.

I know the president is interested in having conversations about artificial intelligence, which I think is key. AI is here to stay. We could stop AI entirely in the United States, and that would not stop China from continuing to do what it is doing with AI. The question is whether there can be an enforceable agreement with China that we can verify, with controls to make sure AI does not get out of control.

But I have to remind everybody: AI is here to stay. Either we will be on the cutting edge of AI, or China will not stop. [...] Any agreement on AI would have to be verifiable. President Reagan used to say about the Soviet Union, “Trust but verify.” When I think of China, it is “distrust and verify.”
